payload.overall_summary: The student demonstrated basic communication competence with appropriate greeting, history-taking, and advice-giving. However, rapport-building was incomplete due to missing purpose statement, and delivery was hindered by rapid speech and long pauses. While the student used teach-back and gave clear instructions, they missed opportunities to verify understanding during history-taking, collaborate on the plan, and fully close the encounter with an open invitation for concerns. Nonverbal behaviors could not be assessed from audio.
